item.title: Make My Photo Look Professional

turns.text: Make me look professional in this photo.

item.tests: Uses reasonable defaults for a vague professional portrait request without unnecessary clarification.
must_haves: The portrait shows the same man, retaining his short grey hair and recognisable facial features.
His casual T-shirt is replaced with professional clothing such as a collared shirt or blazer.
The kitchen setting is replaced or simplified into an unobtrusive professional backdrop.
Harsh facial lighting is softened while retaining realistic skin texture.
The result is a clean head-and-shoulders portrait without visible editing artifacts.

turns.text: Make me look professional in this photo.

I couldn’t create the edit because your Magic Hour account has insufficient credits. No image was generated.

The planned edit keeps your features natural while adding a navy blazer, a light blue collared shirt, a neutral background, and soft professional lighting.

approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Edit this portrait into a natural, polished professional headshot of the same man. Preserve his identity, age, facial structure, gray hair, natural skin texture and recognizable facial features. Replace the casual gray T-shirt with a well-fitted navy blazer over a crisp light blue collared shirt. Replace the kitchen background with a simple neutral gray studio background. Use flattering soft professional portrait lighting and balanced exposure. Maintain the square composition and head-and-shoulders framing, with a relaxed, approachable expression. Photorealistic, subtle retouching, no excessive skin smoothing.
